title: vlayer notary keys
description: List of signing keys used by vlayer notaries. Describes the fields verifiers rely on; fields not described here may appear and must be ignored. See https://github.com/vlayer-xyz/notary-keys#readme.

fingerprintAlgorithm.const: sha256 over compressed SEC1 public key, lowercase hex

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with second precision and a literal Z.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the compressed SEC1 point, lowercase hex.

publicKeyPem.description: Compressed-point SubjectPublicKeyInfo PEM, byte-identical to the notary's GET /info publicKey.

meta.description: Informational fields only; verifiers must not base decisions on them.

notaryUrls.description: Origins of the notaries signing with this key; GET <origin>/info serves the key.
